page.overview:
What is Mossdeep City?

Mossdeep City is a location introduced in Generation III.

Mossdeep City is where Steven Stone lives. To get to Mossdeep, the player needs to Surf trough Route 124. The seventh Gym Leaders, Tate and Liza, are fought here in the Mossdeep City Gym, and both use -type Pokémon. After defeating the Gym in Ruby, Sapphire, Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire), Steven will give the player HM08 (Ruby and Sapphire)/HM07 (Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire) containing Dive.

In the northeast of the city is the Mossdeep Space Center. At one point, it is taken over by Team Magma for rocket fuel. After defeating Team Magma here in , Steven Stone gives the player HM08 (Dive).

After becoming the Champion, Steven leaves a Level 5 (Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald)/Level 1 (Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire) Beldum in his house, along with a letter.
